title: Language exchange app
summary: Practise languages by chatting with native speakers learning yours.
whyTempting: Language learning is huge and conversation practice is the gap.
whyItFails: Unbalanced demand. Everyone wants English partners. Dating/creep problem. Exchange apps attract unwanted advances. Low commitment. Conversations fizzle.
whatWouldChange: AI conversation partners for practice, humans for premium.

attempts.outcome: Closed to new users in 2017, shut down in 2024
Acquired by Rosetta Stone, then closed
attempts.notes: Language-learning community where members practised with each other.

reasons.detail: Unbalanced demand: Everyone wants English partners.
Dating/creep problem: Exchange apps attract unwanted advances.
